import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
header = df.iloc[3]
# Row for Total, 40 years and over, age adjusted
row_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Total, 40 years and over, age adjusted')].index[0]

rates = {}
for col_idx in range(1, len(header), 2):
    yr = str(header[col_idx]).strip()
    val = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[row_idx, col_idx], errors='coerce')
    if pd.notna(val):
        rates[yr] = val

result = max(rates, key=rates.get)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
header = df.iloc[3]
col_2018 = header[header.astype(str).str.contains('2018')].index[0]

# Health insurance status at time of interview -> 40–64 years
row_private = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Private'].index[0]
row_uninsured = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Uninsured'].index[0]

val_private = float(df.iloc[row_private, col_2018])
val_uninsured = float(df.iloc[row_uninsured, col_2018])

result = round(val_private - val_uninsured, 1)
